solutions.title: Math reverse / digit compare
solutions.notes: No string conversion — math reverse / half compare
solutions.description:
**Approach:** Reject negatives; reverse digits (or half the digits) with arithmetic and compare to the original.

**Why preferred:** Matches the common follow-up “solve without converting to a string.”

solutions.title: String reverse
solutions.notes: String reverse — simple, uses O(n) space
solutions.description:
**Approach:** `toString`, reverse characters, compare equality.

**vs recommended:** Fine for clarity. Interviewers often ask for a math-only version to avoid allocation and to practice digit extraction / reverse.
